title: Specialty Pharmacy Program Tiers: Managed Drugs and Dispensing Pharmacy Schedule
content:
The Specialty Pharmacy Program is offered in six tiers. A member's tier is the specialty program the member's plan sponsor elected; the tier sets which pharmacy may dispense a managed specialty drug and what a fill at an outside pharmacy costs the member.

## Sponsor eligibility for each tier

Every tier requires that the sponsor has elected the specialty program. Each tier also has a minimum number of enrolled lives.

| Tier | Sponsor has elected the program | Minimum enrolled lives |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Specialty Open Access | required | 2 |
| Northbridge Specialty Preferred | required | 2 |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive | required | 51 |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive with Copay Assist | required | 101 |
| Northbridge Specialty Care Management | required | 251 |
| Northbridge Specialty Total Care | required | 1001 |

## Drugs managed by the program

On every tier the program manages the same specialty drugs from the Northbridge Rx drug master list: Humira, adalimumab-adaz, Dupixent, Skyrizi, Rinvoq, Enbrel, Biktarvy and Ibrance.

## Dispensing pharmacy terms by tier

- **Exclusive specialty pharmacy**: where this is "Yes", a specialty drug is covered only when Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy dispenses it, once the courtesy fills are used.
- **Outside courtesy fills**: the number of fills of a specialty drug at an outside pharmacy that are covered per drug per plan year before exclusivity applies. The figure is 0 where exclusivity does not apply.
- **Outside-pharmacy coinsurance addition**: the coinsurance added to the plan's specialty cost share when a specialty drug is filled at an outside specialty pharmacy. It is a share of the allowed amount.

| Tier | Exclusive specialty pharmacy | Outside courtesy fills per drug per plan year | Outside-pharmacy coinsurance addition (share of allowed amount) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Specialty Open Access | No | 0 | 0% |
| Northbridge Specialty Preferred | No | 0 | 10% |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive | Yes | 1 | 0% |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive with Copay Assist | Yes | 1 | 0% |
| Northbridge Specialty Care Management | Yes | 1 | 0% |
| Northbridge Specialty Total Care | Yes | 1 | 0% |

## Reading the schedule

- *Which tiers have no exclusivity?* Northbridge Specialty Open Access and Northbridge Specialty Preferred. On both tiers the courtesy-fill figure is 0, because exclusivity does not apply there.
- *On which tier does an outside specialty pharmacy fill add coinsurance?* Only Northbridge Specialty Preferred, where the addition is 10% of the allowed amount. For an assumed allowed amount of $4,000.00, the addition is $400.00 (an illustration only).
- *How many outside fills are covered on an exclusive tier?* One fill per drug per plan year, on each of the four exclusive tiers.
